summary: Project details wireless charging of vechile
details:
Wireless charging of vehicles is a modern technology used to charge electric vehicles (EVs) without connecting charging cables.
It transfers electrical energy from a charging pad on the ground to a receiver coil placed underneath the vehicle using electromagnetic induction.
